SHARED-F-2-S20.title: Consent Data Schema and Persistence Model
SHARED-F-2-S20.description: Define and implement MongoDB schema and Pydantic models for consent records, including tier designation, timestamp, session linkage, and audit metadata. Ensure compatibility with existing consent_models and debug logging.

SHARED-F-2-S21.title: Consent API Endpoints and Tool Exposure
SHARED-F-2-S21.description: Expose consent capture and retrieval via FastAPI endpoints and tool_router integration. Ensure inputs are validated via Pydantic models and routed through allowlisted tools per GOV-004.

SHARED-F-2-S22.title: Consent Enforcement Integration with Tool Router
SHARED-F-2-S22.description: Integrate consent checks into tool_router execution path to ensure all tool invocations respect consent tier before processing or persistence. Block or transform requests when consent requirements are not met.
